what: The provider account ran out of credit mid-run on 2026-11-19 (HTTP 403 AccessDenied.Unpurchased). Before commit 9cbc0c2 the evaluator scored a 403 as a failed task, so every evaluation that saw one measured the infrastructure, not the harness.
